page.layout: One printed page with a running head and page number at the top. Below the head, one full-width engraved plate (cavalry and infantry scene), with two captions printed inside the plate on its right side. No running text on this page. At the right edge of the scan, a fragment of the neighbouring printed page, not transcribed.
page.notes: The scan is rotated 90 degrees: the plate and its captions read from bottom to top. The plate is an engraving showing an armoured horse and rider, a mounted archer, and fallen infantry with shields; the two captions name the cavalry types (cataphractae) and the segmented armour (loricae segmentatae). Only the captions are printed text; the engraving itself has no other words. The text on the right edge belongs to the neighbouring printed page and is not transcribed. The page number is printed in a decorative form and is read as 212.
